title: A compactly supported constant multiple of [[ℝⁿ]] in ℝⁿ has constant zero
statement: Let n ≥ 1, X ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝⁿ) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) and c ∈ ℝ. Suppose X(ω) = c·∫_{ℝⁿ} ω(y)(e₁, …, eₙ) dy for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝⁿ) (TestFormOn univ n), where (e₁, …, eₙ) = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ and dy is Lebesgue measure. If spt X (GeometricCurrentOn.support) is compact, then c = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid n)) n) (c : ℝ), 0 < n → IsCompact X.support → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid n)) n, X ω = c * ∫ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ)) → c = 0
